description: Turn vague UI language into exact, source-backed component and style guidance that coding agents can use directly.

novel_features.name: Agent context pack
novel_features.description: Assemble one bounded, source-backed implementation packet for a component, optional style, and target framework.

novel_features.name: Terminology lint
novel_features.description: Find colloquial or ambiguous UI terms in prose and return canonical, source-backed candidates without rewriting the file.

novel_features.name: Framework crosswalk
novel_features.description: See one UI concept across plain language, component parts, AppKit, SwiftUI, and ARIA or HTML terminology.

novel_features.name: Project UI inventory
novel_features.description: Map UI API symbols in a source tree to canonical components and source references.

novel_features.name: Catalog change impact
novel_features.description: Show which project files may be affected by component or style guidance changes since a prior snapshot.
